entry.title: Mosqitter is turning its mosquito traps into an AI-powered surveillance network
entry.summary: Mosqitter is turning its mosquito-trapping hardware into an AI-powered surveillance network designed to identify species, monitor populations, and provide earlier warnings of mosquito-borne disease risks.

entry.title: Apate sends AI agents undercover to get scammed so they can gather fraud intelligence
entry.summary: Most companies use AI agents to ship products faster or speed up workflows. Apate.ai sends them undercover to get scammed.

entry.title: YouTube Music launches new labels as AI-generated music floods streaming platforms
entry.summary: The label will appear on the player page and include songs entirely generated by AI or partially, such as AI involved in composition and vocals.

entry.title: Hiyd is a health tracker that attaches to the watch you already wear
entry.summary: Former Apple engineers figured out how to get a biometric sensor to attach to your watch without any magnets or adhesives.

entry.title: Ambrosia Energy will build a 10 GWh factory in Texas to make batteries for off-grid data centers
entry.summary: Startup Ambrosia Energy will build a massive factory to crank out batteries to augment solar panels, creating a round-the-clock clean power plant.

entry.title: TimeTeller puts our internal clocks at the center of personalized medicine
entry.summary: German startup TimeTeller has developed a saliva test kit to help anyone understand their circadian rhythm; it aims to reduce side effects from cancer treatments.

entry.title: Electric vehicle sales in the US are showing signs of life
entry.summary: The electric vehicle market in the U.S. has been growing for the last three consecutive quarters.

entry.title: Flock CEO: We haven’t ‘fired’ any police departments as customers
entry.summary: Flock CEO Garrett Langley said that the surveillance company has not canceled contracts of any police department or law enforcement agency, despite reports of abuse.

entry.title: Colossal Biosciences announces new AI platform to help accelerate de-extinction efforts
entry.summary: Colossal announced a new AI platform to help accelerate its de-extinction efforts and Peter Diamandis has launched a new fund to back startups who use it.

entry.title: Flock CEO says its microphones detect ‘just gunshots’ — its website says different
entry.summary: Langley’s comments come amid mounting scrutiny of Flock from privacy advocates, including the ACLU, and members of the public who are concerned about the misuse of its technology.

entry.title: Ambani’s Jio seeks to raise $3.2B in what could be India’s biggest IPO
entry.summary: Jio plans to use most of its IPO proceeds to repay debt as it expands beyond telecom.

entry.title: CedarDB wants one database to handle both transactions and analytics, as AI agents raise the stakes
entry.summary: Databases have traditionally been designed either for analytical data or for operational data. But database engine CedarDB supports both, and its approach has gained relevance with the rise of agentic AI.

entry.title: Intero Biosystems wants drugmakers to test on mini human intestines, not animals
entry.summary: Intero Biosystems is selling lab-grown human intestines to drugmakers as regulators push for alternatives to animal testing, while the startup looks to scale production and expand its organoid technology.

entry.title: Gudea leverages AI to help organizations prevent social media crises before they erupt
entry.summary: Every day, conversations unfold across social media and websites around the world. A seemingly insignificant post—whether it involves AI-generated misinformation, hate speech, or a damaging rumor—can quickly snowball into a much larger public controversy. entry.title: Meet the five companies competing in the Startup Battlefield finals at Disrupt 2026
entry.summary: It’s time to unveil the five companies that will be competing in the Startup Battlefield finals.

entry.title: Flock CEO defends surveillance technology amid national backlash: ‘We shouldn’t pause progress’
entry.summary: At TechCrunch Disrupt, Flock CEO Garrett Langley defended his company's surveillance technology despite growing privacy concerns, arguing that its crime-fighting benefits outweigh the risks of abuse.

entry.title: Ricursive Intelligence is betting on AI-designed chips to help solve the compute crisis
entry.summary: The founders detailed how their startup is developing AI that can design chips, learn from each iteration, and improve subsequent designs, all with the goal of automating and accelerating the chip design process.

entry.title: Figma announces new features to define how agents work on its platform
entry.summary: Figma is also releasing its code layers feature in open beta.

entry.title: Citizen Lab says governments are abusing online ads to hack people with ‘zero-click’ spyware
entry.summary: The digital rights unit found evidence that dozens of devices at media organization Al Jazeera were hacked after being shown malicious online ads.

entry.title: Amazon’s Bee launches two new personal AI devices, starting at $75
entry.summary: Amazon-owned Bee has launched its first new AI devices since its acquisition, including an updated wearable and a credit-card-sized recorder that attaches to smartphones. The devices can summarize conversations, create to-do lists, and integrate with Alexa and Amazon shopping, with prices starting at $74.99.
